snippet.title: The Wooded Beardsman
snippet.description:
#SURVIVAL | OUTDOORS | HUNTING | FISHING | TRAPPING | HOMESTEADING | BUSHCRAFT | CAMPING | SPEARFISHING | TRAVEL | CAMPFIRE COOKING

This channel is about the outdoors and adventure.  Not just about survival, fishing, hunting, trapping, or even bushcraft, but about the whole process of procuring resources necessary for sustenance - wilderness living.  I do not practice ‘catch and release’ or even ‘sport fishing.’  

I do not “harvest.”  Rather, I catch and keep, and consume what I catch.  I would much prefer utilizing nature on my own accord because this gives me a much deeper respect for the animals.

I also enjoy exploring, hiking, fishing, camping, camp fire cooking, exploring, and other crazy things like spearing fish, gigging, building ponds, really anything outside that is fun, I'm up for it, even travelling to new exciting locations to try exotic versions of the things I do around my home turf.

snippet.title: Retired, Now What?
snippet.description:
Welcome to Retired, Now What?

This channel is for anyone stepping into retirement and realizing it’s not just about having more free time. It’s about figuring out what to do with it.

We’ll talk about purpose, routines, hobbies, friendships, family, health, travel, home projects, saving money, and the everyday surprises that come with life after work.

Some parts of retirement are exciting. Some parts are weird. Some parts make you wonder why you’re busier now than when you had a full-time job.

Let’s figure out the next chapter together.

snippet.title: Sesame Workshop
snippet.description:
Sesame Workshop is the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street and so much more. For over 50 years, we have worked at the intersection of education, media, and research, creating joyful experiences that enrich minds and expand hearts. With a mission to help children everywhere grow smarter, stronger, and kinder, we reach families in more than 190 countries with playful early learning so we can empower each generation to build a better world.  
 
Our beloved characters, iconic shows, outreach in communities, and more are rooted in deep expertise and designed to meet children’s most pressing needs. From building school readiness and social problem-solving skills, to nurturing children’s appreciation for nature and encouraging emotional well-being, Sesame Workshop is here for children and families — as every caregiver's valued partner and every child's trusted friend. 

Learn more at www.sesame.org and follow Sesame Workshop on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and X.

snippet.title: Dust to Dream
snippet.description:
Welcome to Dust to Dream When I create cinematic rebuilds of abandoned and forgotten places and turn them into fully functional survival worlds 🌍🏗️

From hidden bunkers deep underground, to remote cabins in nature, to extreme cliffside or underwater structures — I take old, broken or abandoned locations and transform them step by step into something completely new.

Each project is a full transformation story. I don’t just show the final result, but the entire rebuilding process — from cleaning and demolition, through construction, all the way to the final cozy or survival-style interior 😱
Expect:
• Abandoned bunker rebuilds 🏚️➡️🏠
• Survival base transformations 🌲
• Off-grid cabins and tiny homes 🪵
• Extreme location builds (mountains, deserts, forests, water) 🌍
• Cozy, cinematic interiors & storytelling builds 🎥
 • Expect: start-to-finish builds 🧱
 • satisfying renovations

Subscribe for more full transformation builds and hidden world creations 😱🏗️
